text: 过来人说一下四十岁左右的中年人是什么人生体会。
en: Let someone who has been through it describe the life insights of a person around forty.

text: 作为一个男人，四十岁是人生的黄金时刻，精力体力身体状况都处在鼎盛时期。
en: As a man, forty is the golden age of life; one's energy, stamina and physical condition are all at their peak.

text: 工作上，经过多年的磨练，已经成为厂里的技术骨干兼中层领导。
en: At work, after years of tempering, one has become the technical backbone and a mid-level leader in the factory.

text: 老婆也正处在壮年，也是她单位的中坚，孩子正在上高中，学业不上不下，不过乖巧听话，不给大人添麻烦。
en: One's wife is also in her prime, a mainstay at her workplace; the child is in senior high school, with middling academic performance, but is obedient and well-behaved, causing no trouble for the adults.

text: 双方的父母都还健在，身体还算硬朗，还不需要我们夫妻两个费太多的心。
en: Both sets of parents are still alive, fairly hale and hearty, and do not yet require much worry from the two of us as a couple.

text: 楼房刚住进几年，还有点外债需要还。
en: We moved into the flat only a few years ago, and there is still some external debt to repay.

text: 这一时期的体会是什么呢？
en: What is the insight of this stage, then?

text: 幸福与焦虑并存，沉稳和冲动同在，压力和动力相伴。
en: Happiness and anxiety coexist; composure and impulsiveness go together; pressure and motivation accompany one another.

text: 父母双方和岳父岳母都身体硬朗，孩子学业暂时还没到关键的阶段，自己夫妻双方身体正在壮年，在单位也是中坚，工资还可以。
en: Both one's own parents and one's father- and mother-in-law are all hale and hearty; the child's studies have not yet reached a critical stage; both husband and wife are in their prime, mainstays at their units, and the salary is acceptable.

text: 男人拼搏到现在幸福感也是油然而生。
en: A man who has striven to this point naturally feels a sense of happiness welling up.

text: 但是一个男人拼搏到现在，和自己的同学，同事相比，总觉得在钱财，地位，权力方面自己还是比别人差点。
en: But a man who has striven to this point, comparing himself with his classmates and colleagues, always feels he falls a little short of others in wealth, status and power.

text: 唯恐父母，妻子，孩子因此在人面前低人一等而焦虑，因此也已这为动力使自己更加的努力。
en: Anxious lest his parents, wife and children thereby be looked down upon before others, he therefore takes this as motivation to strive even harder.

text: 人到中年，多年的人情世故，工作磨练是自己的性格行事更加沉稳老练，但是只有自己知道，在这沉稳老练的身体里面，有时还有着年轻人的冲动。
en: Reaching middle age, years of social experience and work tempering make one's character and conduct more steady and seasoned, but only one knows that within this steady and seasoned body there is sometimes still the impulsiveness of youth.

text: 说不太好。
en: Not easy to put into words.

text: 身不由己？
en: Not in control of one's own fate?

text: 中年，本就是一段兵荒马乱的岁月。
en: Middle age is, in truth, a time of turmoil and chaos.

text: 当人们步入人生的下半场，面对子女远走、健康逐渐恶化以及生活平淡无奇，无数中年人的内心悲鸣不止。
en: As people enter the second half of life, facing children leaving home, gradually declining health and a bland, uneventful life, countless middle-aged people inwardly lament without end.

text: 当曾经陪伴他们度过无数个春夏秋冬的孩子们告别自己，去闯荡天地，去寻找属于自己的生活和未来，父母们心中不免产生了空虚感和孤独感。
en: When the children who once kept them company through countless springs, summers, autumns and winters say farewell and go off to make their way in the world, to seek their own life and future, a sense of emptiness and loneliness inevitably arises in the parents' hearts.

text: 他们将面临漫长的日子，没有了孩子们的闹腾与陪伴，家里的热闹也悄然散去。
en: They will face long days; without the children's noise and company, the liveliness of the home quietly dissipates.

text: 无论是空荡的房间，还是寂寞的餐桌，都让中年人的心痛不已，曾经的欢声笑语似乎只能在回忆中找到。
en: Whether an empty room or a lonely dining table, both fill the middle-aged with heartache; the laughter and joy of the past seem findable only in memory.

text: 他们失去了最亲近的人，没有人可以倾诉心声，没有人可以陪伴自己度过晚年。
en: They have lost their closest ones; no one to confide their feelings to, no to keep them company in their later years.

text: 他们开始反思：是不是自己在孩子的成长过程中有所欠缺？
en: They begin to reflect: did I fall short in some way during my child's upbringing?

text: 又或者是时光太过匆匆，无法逆转孩子们的离去？
en: Or is it that time passed too swiftly to reverse the children's departure?

text: 曾经的活力与朝气悄然离去，取之而来的是疾病和痛苦的不期而至。
en: Former vitality and vigour quietly depart, and in their place comes the unforeseen arrival of illness and suffering.

text: 他们开始感觉到腰酸背痛，关节疼痛，记忆力下降等问题。
en: They begin to notice problems such as aching backs and waists, joint pain and declining memory.

text: 他们开始意识到生命的脆弱和短暂。
en: They begin to realise the fragility and brevity of life.

text: 无论是疾病的折磨还是痛苦的煎熬，都使得中年人倍感无力。
en: Whether the torment of illness or the agony of suffering, both leave the middle-aged feeling utterly powerless.

text: 他们或许会去寻求医生的帮助，或者通过保持良好的生活习惯来延缓身体的老化。
en: They may seek a doctor's help, or slow the body's ageing by maintaining good habits.

text: 但是，无论怎样，中年人都不得不面对自己逐渐衰老的现实，对未来感到忧虑与不安。
en: But, however they try, the middle-aged must confront the reality of their gradual decline, feeling anxious and uneasy about the future.

text: 当中年人回首过往，发现自己的生活平淡乏味，未能实现自己曾经的梦想时，心中不禁涌起一股深深的追悔之情。
en: When the middle-aged look back on the past and find their life bland and tedious, having failed to realise their former dreams, a deep regret wells up within.

text: 曾经怀揣着满腔热情和理想的他们，如今感到遗憾和失落，思考着人生的意义和价值。
en: They who once cherished boundless enthusiasm and ideals now feel regret and loss, pondering the meaning and value of life.

text: 在年轻的时候，他们或许为了家庭、事业或者社会的压力，放弃了一些追求内心真正渴望的事物。
en: In their youth, perhaps for the sake of family, career or societal pressure, they gave up some things their hearts truly longed for.

text: 他们曾经有过梦想，有过追求，有过对未来的期望，但是生活已经没有了激情和朝气，而梦想似乎也随着时间的流逝而消失了。
en: They once had dreams, had pursuits, had expectations for the future, but life has lost its passion and vitality, and the dreams seem to have vanished with the passage of time.

text: 现实的种种限制和责任，渐渐将他们束缚在一个平凡而安稳的生活中，而他们的梦想却渐行渐远。
en: The various constraints and responsibilities of reality gradually bind them to an ordinary, stable life, while their dreams grow ever more distant.

text: 如今，当他们看到那些勇敢追逐梦想的年轻人时，心中充满了羡慕和嫉妒。
en: Now, when they see those young people bravely chasing their dreams, their hearts fill with envy and jealousy.

text: 他们开始反思自己的选择和决定，想象如果当初能够坚持自己的梦想，生活是否会有所不同。
en: They begin to reflect on their choices and decisions, imagining whether life would have been different had they persisted with their dreams.

text: 当回想起无数次的梦想和追求时，他们才意识到，梦想永远不会消失，只要愿意去追寻。
en: Only when recalling countless dreams and pursuits do they realise that dreams never disappear, as long as one is willing to pursue them.

text: 然而，岁月不等人。
en: Yet time waits for no one.

text: 中年人深刻地意识到，时间已经不再是年少时那样无限延展。
en: The middle-aged deeply realise that time no longer stretches out infinitely as it did in youth.

text: 他们或许已经错过了一些黄金的机遇，无法像年轻时那样奔跑和冒险。
en: They may have missed some golden opportunities, unable to run and take risks as they did in youth.

text: 但是，他们仍然决心不放弃，尽管梦想未能早日实现，却希望能在余下的岁月里找到属于自己的光芒。
en: But they remain determined not to give up; though their dreams were not realised sooner, they hope to find their own light in the remaining years.

text: 于是，中年人开始寻找平衡，在繁忙的工作和生活之余，为自己留出一些时间和空间来追求内心的渴望。
en: Thus the middle-aged begin to seek balance, setting aside some time and space for themselves amid busy work and life to pursue their inner longings.

text: 追悔并不是他们的唯一选择，他们希望通过重新点燃内心的火焰，重新定义自己的人生。
en: Regret is not their only option; they hope, by rekindling the inner flame, to redefine their own lives.

text: 人生总会有自己的起伏，失败不是终点，人仍然可以从失落中恢复过来，并在其他方面实现自己的价值。
en: Life always has its own ups and downs; failure is not the end, and one can still recover from setback and realise one's worth in other ways.

text: 人到中年，最大的清醒，就是不胡思乱想，过低内耗的生活。
en: Reaching middle age, the greatest clarity is to stop overthinking and live a life of low internal friction.

text: 人到中年，更应懂得大多的焦虑都不是现实，与其自我沉沦，不如减少焦虑，掌握自己真实的人生。
en: Reaching middle age, one should understand all the more that most anxiety is not reality; rather than sinking into oneself, it is better to reduce anxiety and take hold of one's true life.

text: 马尔克斯在《百年孤独》中说道：“人生的实质，就是一个人活着，不要对他人心存太多期待。
en: García Márquez wrote in One Hundred Years of Solitude: “The essence of life is to live as an individual, and not to harbour too many expectations of others.

text: 人至中年，历经了酸甜苦辣，见识了世态炎凉，看透了人情冷暖。
en: Having reached middle age, having tasted life's joys and sorrows, having seen the fickleness of the world and seen through the warmth and coldness of human relationships.

text: 渐渐明白，对他人抱有太高期待，是一场灾难。
en: One gradually understands that harbouring too high expectations of others is a disaster.

text: 只有减少期待，才能专注自身，真正做自己。
en: Only by reducing expectations can one focus on oneself and truly be oneself.

text: 真正地认识自己，不在情绪上内耗，不在精神上焦虑，不对他人抱有过高的期待，才是真正地放过自己。
en: To truly know oneself, not to drain oneself emotionally, not to feel anxious in spirit, and not to harbour excessive expectations of others — that is truly letting oneself off the hook.

text: 家庭幸福，事业进步。
en: A happy family and progress in one's career.

text: 宁愿跑起来被拌倒无数次，也不愿规规矩矩走一辈子，就算跌倒也要豪迈的笑。
en: Rather stumble countless times while running, than walk primly one's whole life; even when falling, one should laugh with boldness.

text: 行为决定性格，性格决定命运。
en: Conduct determines character, and character determines destiny.

text: 承受了20多年这个社会的恶意，40岁的时候也差不多要爆发了。
en: Having endured this society's malice for over twenty years, by forty one is about ready to erupt.

text: 感觉中年是一个十字路口。
en: I feel middle age is a crossroads.

text: 很多东西年轻的时候机缘未到不透彻，到中年就有机会看透很多东西，重新审视生命。
en: Many things are not fully understood in youth for lack of opportunity; reaching middle age one has the chance to see through much and re-examine life.

text: 要不就苏醒重生，要不就越来越世俗，平庸，衰败
en: Either awaken and be reborn, or become ever more worldly, mediocre and decline

text: 就是想赚钱，缺钱啊
en: I just want to make money; I'm short of cash.

text: 怎么说呢，这个故事哦，是个大新闻，说的是一个叫恒大的地产巨头闹的一出大戏。
en: How to put it — this story, oh, it's big news, about a property giant called Evergrande and the drama it stirred up.

text: 可别看它负债2万亿，挺吓人的数字，但等等，它可不是手头没钱，账上资产可是有2万多亿的。
en: Don't be fooled by its 2 trillion in debt, a rather frightening figure, but wait — it's not that it has no money; its assets on the books are over 2 trillion too.

text: 不过话说回来，它们这些老板呐，真是把人都当成傻子。
en: That said, these bosses really do take people for fools.

text: 在大庭广众之下转移财产，然后还在海外发了些高息美元债，年息最高达36%哦，这可不是小数目，其中还有不少是老板自己买的。
en: They transfer assets in broad daylight, then issue high-interest dollar bonds overseas, with annual interest as high as 36% — no small sum, and quite a lot of it was bought by the bosses themselves.

text: 公司的钱给自己付高息，还在海外买些不怎么样的项目，把钱洗出去了。
en: They use the company's money to pay themselves high interest, and buy some poor-quality projects overseas, laundering the money out.

text: 这一套操作可不是许家印一个人在搞，恒大里头玩这一套的不止他一个。
en: This set of manoeuvres was not the work of Jiayin Xu alone; inside Evergrande, more than one person played this game.

text: 咱调查恒大的时候发现，无论是恒大财富、恒大地产还是恒大人寿，各种老板们都在学着许家印的样，往国外搬钱。
en: When we investigated Evergrande, we found that whether it was Evergrande Wealth, Evergrande Property or Evergrande Life, all sorts of bosses were following Jiayin Xu's example and moving money abroad.

text: 整个恒大就成了个大“汉奸窝子”。
en: The whole of Evergrande became a great 'den of traitors'.

text: 说起恒大负债这一出戏，光看恒大地产这块，最开始买地皮要10个目标，恒大自己掏了。
en: Speaking of Evergrande's debt drama, just looking at the Evergrande Property part: buying land at first needed 10 targets, and Evergrande paid out of its own pocket.

text: 建房子需要5个目标，恒大不掏，找银行借。
en: Building houses needed 5 targets; Evergrande didn't pay, but borrowed from the bank.

text: 结果恒大不但没还，还用地皮抵押给银行，拿到了10个目标的授信，盖房子的钱也就有了。
en: As a result, not only did Evergrande not repay, it mortgaged the land to the bank and obtained a 10-target credit line, so the money to build houses was there.

text: 借了银行的钱后，恒大又搞了个预售制，让老百姓先交钱，成功收了20个目标。
en: After borrowing from the bank, Evergrande introduced a pre-sale system, getting ordinary people to pay first, and successfully collected 20 targets.

text: 这时候恒大要是把银行欠款还了，盖好房子，应该能赚5个目标。
en: At this point, had Evergrande repaid the bank debt and finished the houses, it should have made 5 targets in profit.

text: 但是，恒大不是这么干的，他们想做大做强，不先还钱。
en: But Evergrande didn't do it that way; they wanted to grow big and strong, and didn't repay first.

text: 于是他们拿着银行借的10个目标和预售的20个目标，跑去其他城市投资。
en: So they took the 10 targets borrowed from the bank and the 20 targets from pre-sales and went to invest in other cities.

text: 这样的操作在三座城市重复了好几遍，90个目标还是没盖房，还继续往其他9座城市投资。
en: This operation was repeated across three cities several times; 90 targets still hadn't gone into building houses, and they kept investing in nine other cities.

text: 期间还把钱用到汽车、矿泉水、足球、影视等行业了。
en: During this period they also put money into industries such as cars, mineral water, football and film and television.

text: 当然了，房子还是要盖的，可恒大又不掏钱，只能让工头垫钱。
en: Of course, the houses still had to be built, but Evergrande again wouldn't pay, so it could only have the foreman advance the money.

text: 工头先垫了5个目标，盖了些房子。
en: The foreman first advanced 5 targets and built some houses.

text: 可是随着房子越盖越多，工头钱不够了，银行开始催债了。
en: But as more houses were built, the foreman ran short of money and the bank began to press for repayment.

text: 恒大突然发现账上负数快变成事实了，“哎呀，我的钱呢？
en: Evergrande suddenly found that a negative balance on the books was fast becoming reality: 'Oh, where has my money gone?

text: ”钱都去买地皮了，还没回款呢。
en: ”The money all went to buy land; it hasn't been recouped yet.

text: 没法，为了还钱，恒大只能停掉部分工地，寄希望于银行继续贷款。
en: With no choice, to repay the debt Evergrande could only halt some construction sites, pinning its hopes on the bank continuing to lend.

text: 这个决策没毛病，先解决大麻烦。
en: This decision was sound; first resolve the big trouble.

text: 但是停的工地想复工可没那么简单，一传消息，追账的纷纷出现；预售的房子也不好卖了；银行也不敢再贷款。
en: But restarting the halted sites was no simple matter; once the news spread, debt collectors appeared in droves; the pre-sold houses became hard to sell; and the bank dared not lend again.

text: 结果就是爆雷了。
en: The result was default.

text: 因为恒大最开始就把城市的未来准楼盘拿去融资了。
en: Because Evergrande, right from the start, used the city's future, soon-to-be-built developments to raise financing.

text: 他们不仅赚了银行的10个目标和预售的20个目标，还有融资得来的5个目标。
en: They not only took the bank's 10 targets and the 20 targets from pre-sales, but also the 5 targets obtained from financing.

text: 最惨的是一线城市的烂尾楼。
en: The most wretched are the unfinished buildings in first-tier cities.

text: 价值15个目标的房子，欠了银行10个、购房者20个、工头5个、信托基金5个，完全是个死结。
en: Houses worth 15 targets owed 10 to the bank, 20 to home buyers, 5 to the foreman and 5 to the trust fund — a complete deadlock.

text: 还有些人可能不懂，我简单解释下恒大负债的情况吧。
en: Some may not understand; let me briefly explain Evergrande's debt situation.

text: 从2021年下半年到2023年初，恒大做了些事情：
en: From the second half of 2021 to early 2023, Evergrande did a few things:

text: 1. 卖房打七折，增加资金流动。
en: 1. Sold houses at a 30% discount to increase cash flow.

text: 2. 削减开支，缩小产业范围，控制现金流。
en: 2. Cut expenditure, narrowed its range of industries and controlled cash flow.

text: 3. 逐渐减少烂尾楼数量。
en: 3. Gradually reduced the number of unfinished buildings.

text: 一直到2022年底，恒大的窟窿缩小了将近七成，未兑付的本息从上千亿缩小到了340亿左右。
en: Right up to the end of 2022, Evergrande's hole shrank by nearly 70%, with the principal and interest yet to be honoured falling from over a hundred billion to around 34 billion.

text: 要是许家印能坚持，把业主的房子交付，把债务还清，他或许还能避免今天这场灾难。
en: Had Jiayin Xu held on, delivered the owners' houses and repaid the debts, he might have avoided today's disaster.

text: 可是进入2023年后，恒大的情况发生了翻天覆地的变化。
en: But after entering 2023, Evergrande's situation changed dramatically.

text: 2023年7月，恒大公布了2021和2022年的财报，结果一公布就震惊全球！
en: In July 2023, Evergrande published its 2021 and 2022 financial reports, and the moment they were released they shocked the world!

text: 财报显示，两年净亏8120.3亿，累计负债高达2.44万亿！
en: The reports showed a net loss of 812.03 billion over two years, with cumulative debt as high as 2.44 trillion!

text: 这个数字，如果分摊给全国人民，每人都要背负1,800块的债务，得干到老才还清，还不算利息。
en: If this figure were divided among the whole population, each person would bear 1,800 yuan of debt and have to work until old age to repay it, interest not included.

text: 这些年恒大分红多少了？
en: How much has Evergrande paid in dividends over these years?

text: 700亿的分红，占恒大76%的股权。
en: 70 billion in dividends, on a 76% stake in Evergrande.

text: 这还只是表面的。
en: And this is only the surface.

text: 据估算，许家印从恒大套现了
en: It is estimated that Jiayin Xu cashed out from Evergrande

text: 2000个目标（还包括“前妻”）。
en: 2,000 targets (also including the 'ex-wife').

text: 这影响下，高管们也都不少套现。
en: Under this influence, the executives also cashed out no small amount.

text: 在恒大爆雷前夕，高层悄悄溜了；不仅高层，听说恒大底层也有不少问题，挥霍成风，实际上都是私吞公款。
en: On the eve of Evergrande's default, the top brass quietly slipped away; and not only the top — it is said the lower ranks also had many problems, a culture of extravagance, in truth all embezzling public funds.

text: 在恒大最后几年，外界看着最难的时候，上面抢着套现走人，下面抢着瓜分，尽量榨干恒大的最后一滴血…
en: In Evergrande's final years, at the time outsiders saw as its hardest, those above scrambled to cash out and leave, those below scrambled to carve it up, squeezing out Evergrande's last drop of blood…

text: 所以许家印呢，可以说是踩着国家的红线走了一遭。
en: So as for Jiayin Xu, one could say he walked right along the state's red lines.

text: 国家忍无可忍，终于出手了，把他们都清算了。
en: The state, unable to bear it any longer, finally acted and brought them all to account.

text: 八月初，恒大的高层陆续被带走调查。
en: In early August, Evergrande's top executives were taken away for investigation one after another.

text: 比如恒大财富的法定代表人杜亮，恒大人寿前董事长朱嘉麟，恒大前首席执行官夏海钧和前首席财务官潘大荣，最后连许家印也被强制措施拘留，恒大也到此为止了，其他地产公司呢？
en: For example, Liang Du, the legal representative of Evergrande Wealth; Jialin Zhu, former chairman of Evergrande Life; Haijun Xia, former CEO of Evergrande; and Darong Pan, former CFO — and in the end even Jiayin Xu was detained under compulsory measures. And that was the end of Evergrande. What about the other property companies?

text: 比如融创？
en: Sunac, for instance?

text: 碧桂园？
en: Country Garden?

text: 还有其他的地产公司呢？
en: And the other property companies?

text: 去年年底，碧桂园杨老板卖了碧桂园服务7.03%股份，套现超50亿港元；
en: At the end of last year, Boss Yang of Country Garden sold 7.03% of Country Garden Services shares, cashing out over 5 billion Hong Kong dollars;

text: 上上个月19号，总裁李长江清仓式减持公司股份，套现约2824.72万港元；
en: On the 19th of the month before last, President Changjiang Li made a clearance-style reduction of his company shares, cashing out about 28.2472 million Hong Kong dollars;

text: 上上个月30号，碧桂园杨老板把20%碧桂园服务股权捐给国强公益基金会，价值约64亿港元（注意，基金会的创始成员是杨惠妍的妹妹杨子莹，慈善公益基金不允许清算）；
en: On the 30th of the month before last, Boss Yang of Country Garden donated 20% of Country Garden Services equity to the Guoqiang Public Welfare Foundation, worth about 6.4 billion Hong Kong dollars (note: the foundation's founding member is Ziying Yang, the younger sister of Huiyan Yang, and a charitable public-welfare fund may not be liquidated);

text: 上个月，碧桂园连两笔美元债的利息都支付不起，宣布债券兑付存在重大不确定性。
en: Last month, Country Garden could not even pay the interest on two dollar bonds, announcing major uncertainty over bond redemption.

text: 和许老板的操作差不多节奏，遇到问题，先减持套现，然后搞个开曼群岛的来隔离风险。
en: Much the same rhythm as Boss Xu's manoeuvres: when trouble arises, first reduce holdings and cash out, then set up something in the Cayman Islands to isolate the risk.

text: 他们可是搞了个“收益个人化，成本社会化，风险全民化，慈善全球化”的套路。
en: They really went for the playbook of 'privatising gains, socialising costs, nationalising risks, globalising charity.'

text: 责任？
en: Responsibility?

text: 在美国…
en: In America…

text: 这2.4万亿的恒大负债跟许老板算个屁啊？
en: This 2.4 trillion in Evergrande debt — what is it to Boss Xu?

text: 碧桂园在开曼群岛注册，跟杨惠妍什么关系啊？
en: Country Garden is registered in the Cayman Islands — what relation is that to Huiyan Yang?

text: 债务不是凭空产生也不会凭空消失，最后谁来买单？
en: Debt does not arise from nothing, nor vanish into nothing; in the end, who pays the bill?

text: 监管失灵，结果是我们买单，又无可奈何…
en: Regulatory failure means we end up paying, with no recourse…

text: 谁能吃苦，就得吃苦吧…
en: Whoever can bear hardship must bear it…

text: 那些烂尾楼啊，简直是个笑话。
en: Those unfinished buildings — they're practically a joke.

text: 把六个
en: Take six
